categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the Tests label and refactors test framework node termination utilities to address sanitizer runner issues.
categories.rationale: Prevents noisy test environment failures by replacing abrupt process kills with graceful SIGTERM termination. According to the PR description, this resolves #36388 by avoiding 'llvm-symbolizer broken pipe complaints' when resolving UBSAN suppressions during test execution.
